"""Data access layer to decouple plugins from database models."""

from abc import ABC, abstractmethod
from typing import Optional

from .database import thumb, df_thumb, del_thumb
from .db import get_caption, update_cap, del_caption


class AbstractThumbnailStore(ABC):
    """Abstract interface for thumbnail persistence."""

    @abstractmethod
    async def save(self, user_id: int, msg_id: int) -> None:
        """Save or replace thumbnail for user."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def delete(self, user_id: int) -> None:
        """Delete thumbnail for user."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def get(self, user_id: int):
        """Retrieve thumbnail record for user."""
        pass


class AbstractCaptionStore(ABC):
    """Abstract interface for caption persistence."""

    @abstractmethod
    async def save(self, user_id: int, caption: str) -> None:
        """Save or replace caption for user."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def delete(self, user_id: int) -> None:
        """Delete caption for user."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def get(self, user_id: int):
        """Retrieve caption record for user."""
        pass


class ThumbnailRepository(AbstractThumbnailStore):
    """Concrete implementation using existing database functions."""

    async def save(self, user_id: int, msg_id: int) -> None:
        await df_thumb(user_id, msg_id)

    async def delete(self, user_id: int) -> None:
        await del_thumb(user_id)

    async def get(self, user_id: int):
        return await thumb(user_id)


class CaptionRepository(AbstractCaptionStore):
    """Concrete implementation using existing database functions."""

    async def save(self, user_id: int, caption: str) -> None:
        await update_cap(user_id, caption)

    async def delete(self, user_id: int) -> None:
        await del_caption(user_id)

    async def get(self, user_id: int):
        return await get_caption(user_id)


# Global singleton instances (can be overridden in tests/config)
thumbnail_repo = ThumbnailRepository()
caption_repo = CaptionRepository()
